QF.id: Cat III AIF Overview and Growth_37

question.text: A recent classification criterion introduced by SEBI is:

answer.text: Specified AIF, a fourth/additional AIF category inserted by SEBI for which detailed regulations shall be laid out

explanation.text: The Logic: Pages 35 and 90 of the source describe Specified AIF as a fourth/additional registration category that SEBI has inserted alongside Categories I, II and III, with detailed regulations to be separately laid out. The Trap: Retail AIF, NRI-only AIF and Government AIF are not SEBI-recognised AIF categories under the AIF Regulations. Note: The source does not explicitly say Specified AIF is for "funds that don't fall under Cat I/II/III" — that phrasing should be avoided when citing pages 35 and 90.
